speaker: Doctor
text:
The fundoscopy results showing granular yellow-white opacities around retinal vessels and dot-blot hemorrhages are highly suggestive of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis, which is an AIDS-defining illness. To confirm this, I need to assess your overall immune status and check for other systemic signs.

REQUEST TEST: CD4_Count
REQUEST TEST: Plasma_Viral_Load
How long have you noticed these vision changes, and do you see floaters or flashes of light?

speaker: Doctor
text:
The CD4 count of 36/mm³ confirms severe immunosuppression, which strongly supports a diagnosis of CMV retinitis. Your plasma viral load being normal rules out acute HIV replication as the primary cause.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis
